title: Sprinkler (sprinklers/items/<id>/sprinkler.json)
description: A model of lawn sprinkler, as a watering circuit of the house view uses it: what it throws (a fixed fan, one rotating jet, several rotating streams), how far it reaches and the arc it covers. The numbers only pre-fill a head when it is placed: its reach and its arc stay the user's to set.

name.description: Name of the model (Pro-Spray PSU-04-15A). A model name seldom differs from one language to another: English alone is the rule here.

brand.description: Maker (Hunter, Rain Bird, Gardena). Left out for a model that belongs to none.

kind.description: What it throws: `spray` a fixed fan of water, `rotor` one jet sweeping its arc, `rotator` several slow rotating streams (MP Rotator and the like). The view draws the jets accordingly.

radius.description: How far it throws, in metres: the usual reach of the model, and the bounds its nozzle can be set between.

arc.description: The arc it can cover, in degrees.
